explication: Apple Notes Exporter reads notes and their hierarchy from the macOS Notes store, lets users select and filter them, converts note content and attachments into many export formats, then delivers them as a folder tree, archive, or joined file. The same export engine is exposed through the GUI, CLI, Shortcuts, and an MCP server; incremental runs track changes and prune removed notes. The graph preserves documented capabilities, but some format and delivery internals are unsampled, so uncertain connections are omitted.
